title: Supply Chain Optimization: Profit Leakage & Delivery Performance Analysis
summary: Analysis of profit leakage and delivery performance to identify revenue recovery opportunities and improve fulfilment performance.
problem: DataCo Global faced significant profit losses and delays in order fulfilment.
goal: Reduce late delivery rate from 57.3% to 42.8%
Improve fulfilment performance through conditional same-day delivery and 3PL SLA enforcement
keyFindings: 82.2% of losses concentrated in Fan Shop, Apparel, and Golf
57.3% of orders experienced late delivery, particularly in Europe and LATAM
recommendations: Cap discounts at 15% with A/B testing
Reallocate discount savings to fund conditional same-day delivery
